title: A King's Book of Games in Times of War
body: During a time of family rebellion and war, a Spanish king named Alfonso the Tenth ordered the creation of a beautiful book about board games. Completed in 1283, this famous manuscript detailed the rules of chess, dice, and backgammon. Later, the king even added a special section for a giant version of chess and games based on the stars.

variants.lucy: Long ago in Spain, King Alfonso lived through a loud and scary war, even fighting with his own family. To find a quiet space of peace, he asked his artists to paint a wonderful book filled with the secrets of chess, backgammon, and dice. Inside its colorful pages, he even drew giant chessboards and games that followed the movement of the silent stars.
variants.luca: While battles raged outside his castle walls, King Alfonso decided to launch a totally different kind of mission. In 1283, he finished a master plan of a book packed with rules for chess and dice battles. He even upgraded the adventure by adding giant-sized chess and games played with the actual stars!
variants.cn: 很久很久以前，在西班牙，阿方索国王经历了一场又吵又吓人的战争，连自己的家人都跟他打了起来。为了找到一块安静的小天地，他请画师们画了一本特别棒的书，里面藏着国际象棋、双陆棋和骰子游戏的秘密。在五彩缤纷的书页里，他还画下了巨大的棋盘，以及跟着夜空中静悄悄的星星移动的游戏呢。

source.author: Alfonso X (Castilla), ed. Raúl Orellana Calderón
